purpose: bind each executable to the libraries it actually resolves at runtime, under the profile's environment contract
note: an absolute executable path alone does not identify which shared libraries are loaded. The modified and stock libraries share SONAMES, so both rows and the resolution order are recorded.

reactingFoam.note: the package's own reactingFoam, built against the real-fluid libraries; NOT the stock executable of the same name

stock_executable_of_same_name.note: unchanged and still present; the two are distinct binaries that share a name

what_it_does: sources the stock OpenFOAM-8 bashrc (provides wmake, compiler wrappers, stock infrastructure libraries)
sets LIB_rfFoam8_SRC to the package's src directory, as the package's Make/options require
overrides FOAM_USER_APPBIN and FOAM_USER_LIBBIN to profile-specific directories
puts the profile library directory first on LD_LIBRARY_PATH
puts the profile binary directory first on PATH
redirects compiler temporaries to /data2 because the root filesystem is full
invocation_contract.caveat: this is a host-built toolchain invoked through a sourced shell environment, not a container image. The containerised agent runtime and this toolchain are separate objects; a trial that invokes this solver must do so through this contract or state clearly what differed.
